source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
As each player's turn ends, both players do this, the active player first:

1. For each Secondary Mission whose conditions you met, you can score the VP it lists. With Tactical Secondary Missions, discard each card you score this way; it is achieved.
2. On your own turn only, with Tactical Secondary Missions, you may discard at least 1 active Secondary Mission to gain 1 CP.

score.condition: met the conditions of a Secondary Mission
